name: Luke Skywalker
subtitle: Jedi Knight (Archive)
lore: Luke stands at the center of the Rebellion mythos, balancing hope, discipline, and the weight of legacy as he grows from farm boy to Jedi Knight.

name: Darth Vader
subtitle: Obi-Wan Kenobi
lore: Vader projects raw Imperial menace, a collector centerpiece whose visual power comes from silhouette, restraint, and relentless presence.

name: Ahsoka Tano
subtitle: The Mandalorian
lore: Ahsoka bridges eras and fan generations, bringing dual-saber elegance and deep Clone Wars history into the post-Empire frontier.

name: Captain Rex
subtitle: Phase II Armor
lore: Rex represents disciplined leadership and battle-worn loyalty, making him a cornerstone figure for Clone Wars shelves.

name: Bo-Katan Kryze
subtitle: Mandalorian Loyalist
lore: Bo-Katan anchors Mandalorian display lines with royal armor, leadership tension, and a striking blue-and-silver visual identity.

name: Han Solo
subtitle: Endor
lore: Han’s Endor look mixes rugged practicality with command energy, perfect for collectors building battle-of-Endor storytelling shelves.

name: Moff Gideon
subtitle: Dark Trooper Armor
lore: Gideon’s armored variant is pure shelf drama, designed for collector impact with angular plating and authoritarian menace.

name: Cal Kestis
subtitle: Gaming Greats
lore: Cal brings modern game-era storytelling into Black Series form, blending weathered gear, focused posture, and survivor grit.

name: Boba Fett
subtitle: Tython Armor
lore: Battle-scarred armor, decisive stance, and massive fan appeal make this Boba an easy centerpiece for any modern bounty shelf.

name: Rey
subtitle: Jedi Training
lore: Rey’s training-era design gives sequel displays a grounded, transitional look with strong silhouette clarity and staff-to-saber lineage.

name: Stormtrooper
subtitle: Jedha Patrol
lore: A patrol trooper variant adds texture to Imperial shelves, giving army builders another strong silhouette and world-building beat.

name: B1 Battle Droid
subtitle: Geonosis
lore: The B1 battle droid adds classic prequel battlefield texture, especially for collectors building Geonosis or CIS displays.
